actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the extension toolbar button, resolved from "__MSG_actionTitle__" in manifest.json (action.default_title). This is a brand name, not a phrase: it must be byte-identical in every catalog, same as extName. Do not translate or transliterate - reproduce it exactly as written.

extDescription.message: Tracks and counts your played tracks and listening stats on YouTube Music.
extDescription.description: The extension description, resolved from "__MSG_extDescription__" in manifest.json and shown by the browser in the extension manager and in the Chrome Web Store / AMO listing. Unlike extName this string IS translated into every locale - it is the store listing copy a user reads before installing. Note the platform limitation: the browser resolves it from its OWN locale at install/update time, so it follows the browser language and not the in-app language setting. Keep it under the ~132-character store limit.

extName.description: The extension name, resolved from "__MSG_extName__" in manifest.json and shown by the browser in the extension manager, the toolbar tooltip list and the store listing. This is a brand name, not a phrase: it must be byte-identical in every catalog. Do not translate, transliterate, localize, capitalize differently or add diacritics - reproduce it exactly as written.

msg_about_blurb.message: $1 keeps a running tally of everything you play on YouTube Music. It counts every track you listen to, tracks per-song and per-artist play counts, recognizes completed albums, and measures your listening time. Everything stays in your browser.
msg_about_blurb.description: The About panel's main marketing paragraph. $1 is the extension's brand name and must stay byte-identical; "YouTube Music" is a product name and is not translated. Preserve the selling points in order: counting every play, accurate per-song and per-artist counts, album completion detection, and measured listening time. The last sentence is the local-only guarantee - keep it a plain factual statement, do not expand it into a policy claim.

msg_about_link_email.description: Label of the link that opens the author's email address. First person, matching the author's voice.

msg_about_link_report.message: Report an issue or request a feature
msg_about_link_report.description: Label of the link to the issue tracker. Covers both bug reports and feature requests, so translate it as one label for both purposes rather than splitting it.

msg_about_link_source.description: Label of the link to the public source repository.

msg_about_made_with.description: Page footer credit. $1 is the author's handle and must be reproduced exactly, never translated or transliterated. The '<3' is a heart emoticon - keep it, or substitute the target locale's equivalent heart symbol.

msg_about_panel_subtitle.message: Everything about this extension and how to reach me.
msg_about_panel_subtitle.description: Sub-heading under the About title. Written in the first person by the extension's author; keep the first-person voice.

msg_about_panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the About tab. Short - one word preferred.

msg_about_section_contact.description: Heading of the About panel section listing the contact and support links.

msg_about_version_label.description: Word preceding the version number in the About card. The version number itself is injected by JS and is never translated.

msg_about_whats_new.description: Text preceding the version number in the changelog heading. Ends mid-phrase - the version number follows it - so do not add a full stop and keep it open-ended.

msg_album_completed_title.description: Tooltip on the star badge drawn over the cover of an album that has been played through to completion. Rendered fresh on every card; nothing is persisted under this text.

msg_album_cover_alt.description: Alt text for an album cover image when there is no album name available to use as its label. Display only: the stored value is never rewritten.

msg_album_hide_tracks.description: Label of the button on an album card while its track list is expanded. The opposite state reads as "View Tracks".

msg_album_played_songs_header.description: Heading above an album's track list when the full official tracklist is not known yet, so only the songs actually heard are listed. $1 is the number of distinct songs played.

msg_album_status_completed.description: Status pill of an album card that has been played to completion. $1 is the number of complete playthroughs. Keep the star and the "x" multiplier marker as written; both read the same in every language.

msg_album_status_completed_next.description: Status pill of a completed album that also shows how far the next playthrough has got. $1 complete playthroughs so far, $2 tracks matched so far in the next playthrough, $3 tracks on the album.

msg_album_status_played_songs_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_album_status_played_songs" plural set, selected with plural('msg_album_status_played_songs', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_album_status_played_songs_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_album_status_played_songs" plural set, selected with plural('msg_album_status_played_songs', n).

msg_album_status_progress.description: Status pill of an album that is part-way through: how many of its songs have been heard. $1 songs heard, $2 songs on the album, $3 percentage complete.

msg_album_total_plays_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_album_total_plays" plural set, selected with plural('msg_album_total_plays', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_album_total_plays_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_album_total_plays" plural set, selected with plural('msg_album_total_plays', n).

msg_album_tracks_header.description: Heading above an album's track list once the full official tracklist has been resolved. $1 is the length of that tracklist.

msg_album_view_tracks.description: Label of the button on an album card while its track list is collapsed. The opposite state reads as "Hide Tracks".

msg_albums_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_albums" plural set, selected with plural('msg_albums', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_albums_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_albums" plural set, selected with plural('msg_albums', n).

msg_artist_unknown.description: Stand-in for a missing artist name, shown in the scanner's now-playing line and in the song and album lists. "Unknown" is a persisted sentinel that also travels inside export bundles, so it is translated only where it is displayed and never on the way into storage.

msg_artists_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_artists" plural set, selected with plural('msg_artists', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_artists_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_artists" plural set, selected with plural('msg_artists', n).

msg_cache_clear_error.description: Inline error shown after the cover thumbnail cache could not be cleared. $1 is the underlying failure text from the cache layer.

msg_cache_cleared.description: Inline confirmation shown after the cover thumbnail cache has been emptied.

msg_cache_covers_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_cache_covers" plural set, selected with plural('msg_cache_covers', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_cache_covers_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_cache_covers" plural set, selected with plural('msg_cache_covers', n).

msg_cache_size_kb.description: Cover cache size in kilobytes. The divisor is binary (1024) and $1 is already rounded to one decimal place. Keep the unit attached to the number.

msg_cache_size_mb.description: Cover cache size in megabytes. The divisor is binary (1024x1024) and $1 is already rounded to two decimal places.

msg_cache_size_refreshed.description: Inline confirmation shown after the cover cache statistics were re-read on demand.

msg_completedTimes.description: Tooltip on the star mark next to an album in the popup's Completed Albums tab. Means the album was played start to finish $1 times. Do not confuse 'completed' (listened to the whole album in one sitting) with 'tracked' (individual songs registered).

msg_content_badge_play_one.description: Singular noun shown beside the play count in the player-bar badge. Singular form of the counted "play". Deliberately carries no number: the count is a separate DOM element. French selects this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_content_badge_play_other.description: Plural noun shown beside the play count in the player-bar badge. Carries no number - the count is a separate DOM element. en, de, es, it and fr all select this form for two or more plays.

msg_content_badge_title_one.message: You have listened to this song $1 time
msg_content_badge_title_one.description: Tooltip on the play-count badge in the YouTube Music player bar, singular form. $1 is the play count as a bare number. Translate the whole sentence, not just a noun, so that it agrees grammatically with the number.

msg_content_badge_title_other.message: You have listened to this song $1 times
msg_content_badge_title_other.description: Tooltip on the play-count badge in the YouTube Music player bar, plural form (also used for 0 in most languages). $1 is the play count as a bare number. Translate the whole sentence, not just a noun, so that it agrees grammatically with the number.

msg_content_count_new_play_one.description: Count of plays newly imported by a history sync, singular. $1 is the number of new plays. This is the "new" counterpart of msg_content_count_play and appears only in sync-result messages.

msg_content_count_new_play_other.description: Count of plays newly imported by a history sync, plural. $1 is the number of new plays. en, de, es, it and fr select this form for two or more.

msg_content_count_play_one.description: Counted number of listening plays, singular. $1 is the play count. Used inside longer sentences where the noun has to agree with the number, so it must work as a phrase on its own.

msg_content_count_play_other.description: Counted number of listening plays, plural. $1 is the play count. en, de, es, it and fr all select this form for two or more plays. In music contexts "play" means one complete listen to a song, not a partial or a stream.

msg_content_count_song_one.description: Counted number of songs, singular. $1 is the song count. Used inside the history scanner's progress sentence. French selects this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_content_count_song_other.description: Counted number of songs, plural. $1 is the song count. Here "song" means an entry in the YouTube Music listening history.

msg_content_scan_boundary_progress.message: Scanning history... Loaded $1. Looking for sync boundary...
msg_content_scan_boundary_progress.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay shown on each tick while the scanner scrolls the History page looking for the position where the last sync stopped. $1 arrives already pluralized, e.g. "57 songs". Treat $1 as a finished phrase. Three clauses, each with an ellipsis, matching the three stages of the scan.

msg_content_scan_checking_since.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay when a scan starts from a stored sync position. $1 is the title of the most recently synced song, as it appears on YouTube Music - it is remote data, inserted as plain text inside the quotes, and may itself contain quotation marks. Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis.

msg_content_scan_empty_history.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay when a scan found nothing at all and there was no previous sync to compare against. Full sentence with a full stop. Note this says "tracks" rather than "songs" for variety with the other scanner strings; keep the distinction if your language makes it.

msg_content_scan_failed.description: Error status line of the history-scanner overlay. $1 is the underlying failure text from the extension's background process - an exception message, not a translatable sentence, so it is left in English inside the localized frame. Do not try to translate $1.

msg_content_scan_saving.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay while the plays found by a scan are being written to storage. $1 arrives already pluralized, e.g. "12 plays". Treat $1 as a finished phrase. Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis.

msg_content_scan_scanning_history.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay when a scan starts and there is no stored sync position to compare against, so the whole history is being walked. Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis.

msg_content_scan_success.description: Bolded lead-in of the history-scanner overlay's success status line, followed by a sentence saying how much was synced. A short standalone phrase with no verb and no trailing punctuation beyond the exclamation mark.

msg_content_scan_synced.description: Success status line of the history-scanner overlay when a sync finished normally. $1 arrives already pluralized, e.g. "12 new plays". Treat $1 as a finished phrase. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_content_scan_synced_reason.description: Success status line of the history-scanner overlay when the sync finished with something worth explaining - it hit the history limit, walked the whole list, or the page was left mid-scan. $1 arrives already pluralized ("12 new plays"); $2 is an already-localized short phrase explaining why, e.g. "Reached the 200-song history limit." Treat both as finished sentences and keep the two-sentence shape.

msg_content_scan_up_to_date.message: All caught up! No new plays found.
msg_content_scan_up_to_date.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay when a sync ran and the listening history contains nothing newer than the last sync. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_content_scanner_force_rescan.message: Re-scan full history from the beginning
msg_content_scanner_force_rescan.description: Label of the checkbox in the history-scanner overlay. Checking it ignores the stored sync position and walks the entire listening history again.

msg_content_scanner_metric_label.description: Caption above the running counter in the history-scanner overlay. The number under it is how many songs the last sync imported.

msg_content_scanner_minimize.description: Tooltip on the X button of the history-scanner overlay, in its expanded state. The button collapses the overlay rather than closing it.

msg_content_scanner_ready.message: Ready to sync your listening history.
msg_content_scanner_ready.description: Status line of the history-scanner overlay while it is idle and no sync has been started. A full sentence with a full stop.

msg_content_scanner_restore.description: Tooltip on the history-scanner overlay's collapse button while the overlay is minimized.

msg_content_scanner_title.description: Title of the history-scanner overlay the extension injects onto the YouTube Music History page. Keep it short: it is the overlay's header, next to a logo. This is the extension's own feature name, not a translated brand - do NOT use the product name as a substitute.

msg_content_scanner_toggle_minimize.description: Tooltip on the header title of the history-scanner overlay, which is clickable and expands the overlay again after it has been minimized.

msg_count_hour_one.description: Whole hours in the popup's total listening time, singular. Abbreviated to match the compact space the popup gives this line; use the usual short form for hours in your language (e.g. 'h' in French, 'Std' in German).

msg_count_hour_other.description: Whole hours in the popup's total listening time, plural (also used for 0).

msg_count_minute_one.description: Whole minutes in the popup's total listening time, singular. Abbreviated to match the compact space the popup gives this line; use the usual short form for minutes in your language (e.g. 'min' in French and German, 'min' in Spanish and Italian).

msg_count_minute_other.description: Whole minutes in the popup's total listening time, plural (also used for 0).

msg_count_play_one.description: How many times a song, artist or album has been played, singular. 'Play' means one registered playback of a track - the unit the popup's Top Songs, Top Artists and Top Albums lists count in, and the unit the hero 'Total Plays' counter uses. Keep it consistent with the count words elsewhere in the UI.

msg_count_play_other.description: How many times a song, artist or album has been played, plural (also used for 0 in most languages). One registered playback of a track per 'play'.

msg_count_song_one.description: How many distinct tracks an album contains, singular. Shown on each Completed Albums row as '<n> songs - <n> plays', i.e. how many of the album's tracks were ever registered.

msg_count_song_other.description: How many distinct tracks an album contains, plural (also used for 0 in most languages). Shown on each Completed Albums row before the play count.

msg_counterTotalPlays.description: Caption above the large total-play number in the popup's hero counter block.

msg_debug_boundary_date.description: Sync-boundary row of the debug panel for the legacy day-header boundary format. $1 is the date header from the history page; $2 is an already-pluralized play phrase such as "5 plays".

msg_debug_boundary_none.description: Sync-boundary row of the debug panel before the first sync has established one.

msg_debug_console_cleared.description: Contents of the debug log pane right after the Clear Logs button is pressed.

msg_debug_queueing.description: Transient label of the "Fetch Missing Tracklists" button while the backfill request is being queued.

msg_debug_storage.description: Storage summary row of the debug panel. All four arguments arrive already pluralized, in the order plays, songs, artists, albums (e.g. "1 play, 40 songs, 12 artists, 9 albums"). Keep the order and treat each as a finished phrase.

msg_debug_tab_connected_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_debug_tab_connected" plural set, selected with plural('msg_debug_tab_connected', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_debug_tab_connected_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_debug_tab_connected" plural set, selected with plural('msg_debug_tab_connected', n).

msg_debug_tab_none.description: YouTube Music tab row of the debug panel when no music.youtube.com tab is open.

msg_debug_tab_unreachable.description: YouTube Music tab row of the debug panel when a YouTube Music tab is open but its content script did not answer.

msg_debug_tracklists_all_resolved.description: Enrichment status tag after a manual tracklist backfill found nothing left to fetch.

msg_debug_tracklists_queued_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_debug_tracklists_queued" plural set, selected with plural('msg_debug_tracklists_queued', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_debug_tracklists_queued_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_debug_tracklists_queued" plural set, selected with plural('msg_debug_tracklists_queued', n).

msg_debug_watermark.description: Sync-boundary row of the debug panel for the current watermark format. $1 is an already-pluralized track phrase such as "200 tracks", $2 is the title of the newest entry. $2 comes from YouTube Music and is inserted as plain text.

msg_details_albums_empty_state.message: No albums tracked yet. Sync your listening history or play an album to get started.
msg_details_albums_empty_state.description: Empty state shown in the album breakdown list when the user has no tracked albums. Two sentences: state the problem, then suggest the two ways out (syncing history, or simply playing an album). details.js renders this same string in a generated card - keep the two identical.

msg_details_albums_refresh.description: Button that re-reads the album breakdown from storage.

msg_details_albums_section_title.description: Heading of the per-album breakdown section on the Overview tab.

msg_details_albums_show_all_albums.description: Initial label of the button that expands the album list from the top 3 to every tracked album. details.js overwrites this label with a counted variant once more than 3 albums exist, so this uncounted form is the pre-data / under-threshold state.

msg_details_albums_show_all_count.description: Label of the Top 3 / Show All toggle while the top-three view is showing, as rendered from JS with the album count attached. $1 is the total number of tracked albums. The same span (#toggleAllAlbumsText) carries msg_details_albums_show_all_albums as its pre-render default in details.html; the JS value always wins once the list is rendered.

msg_details_albums_show_top3_only.description: Label of the Top 3 / Show All toggle while the full list is showing, as rendered from JS. Shared span with msg_details_albums_show_all_count.

msg_details_albums_subtext_default.message: See which songs you've heard from each album and track your progress.
msg_details_albums_subtext_default.description: Sub-heading of the per-album breakdown section, shown when 3 or fewer albums are tracked and there is no top-3/show-all toggle to describe. details.js reuses this exact string in that state - keep the two call sites identical.

msg_details_albums_subtext_showing_all.description: Sub-line under the Albums Breakdown heading while the full album list is open, as rendered from JS. $1 is the total number of tracked albums. The same node (#albumsSectionSubtext) carries msg_details_albums_subtext_default as its pre-render default in details.html.

msg_details_albums_subtext_showing_top3.message: Showing Top 3 most played albums ($1 total tracked).
msg_details_albums_subtext_showing_top3.description: Sub-line under the Albums Breakdown heading while only the three most-played albums are listed, as rendered from JS. $1 is the total number of tracked albums.

msg_details_page_title.description: Browser tab / window title of the Details page. $1 is the extension's brand name and must stay byte-identical in every locale.

msg_details_panel_subtitle.message: Your personal listening statistics and history on YouTube Music.
msg_details_panel_subtitle.description: Sub-heading under the Overview title. "YouTube Music" is a product name and is not translated.

msg_details_panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the first tab. Refers to the statistics summary of what the user has played.

msg_details_stat_albums.description: Label of the statistic card counting the albums the user has played tracks from. Music-industry sense of 'album', not a generic 'book'.

msg_details_stat_albums_finished.description: Label of the statistic card counting albums where the user has heard every track. Past participle - keep it as a completed action, not a future one.

msg_details_stat_artists.description: Label of the statistic card counting distinct artists the user has played.

msg_details_stat_different_songs.description: Label of the small statistic card for the count of DISTINCT songs played, as opposed to the total number of plays. "Different" must not be read as a translation of the artist or album sense.

msg_details_stat_singles.description: Label of the statistic card counting standalone track releases the user has played, as opposed to tracks that belong to an album.

msg_details_stat_time_listened.description: Label of the small statistic card showing accumulated listening duration.

msg_details_stat_time_zero_min.description: Initial placeholder shown in the Time Listened card before the real duration is computed. JS replaces this immediately; keep it short and keep the abbreviation.

msg_details_stat_total_songs_desc.message: Total number of songs played while using the extension.
msg_details_stat_total_songs_desc.description: Explanation under the hero statistic. Clarifies that only listens recorded by this extension are counted.

msg_details_stat_total_songs_played.description: Label of the large hero statistic on the Overview tab. A play = one started song on YouTube Music, NOT a unique track and NOT a stream of audio; keep it distinct from the 'Different Songs' label next to it.

msg_details_unit_total_plays.description: Unit shown immediately after the large total-plays number. It is a standalone unit label, not a counted phrase, so it must stay grammatical on its own and must NOT be given a plural form.

msg_durationUnderOneMinute.description: Popup hero, total continuous listening time, when the total is under a minute but not zero. Keep the leading '<' - it means 'less than' and must not be dropped. Translate only the unit.

msg_emptyAlbums.description: Empty-state message shown in the popup's Top Albums tab when no album has been played from start to finish yet. This list only ever contains completed albums, so do not reword it as 'no albums tracked'. Shared by the inline <li class="empty-state"> in popup.html and by popup.js, which must use this same key.

msg_emptyArtists.description: Empty-state message shown in the popup's Top Artists tab when no song has been played yet, so no artist statistics exist. Shared by the inline <li class="empty-state"> in popup.html and by popup.js, so the two call sites cannot drift apart.

msg_emptySongs.description: Empty-state message shown in the popup's Top Songs tab when no song has been played yet, so no song statistics exist. Shared by the inline <li class="empty-state"> in popup.html and by popup.js, so the two call sites cannot drift apart.

msg_enrich_step_done.message: Album metadata is up to date.
msg_enrich_step_done.description: Scanner-panel line for the album-metadata backfill once it has finished. This is not a history sync and must not be worded as one.

msg_enrich_step_scanning.description: Scanner-panel line while the album-metadata backfill is running. It shares the panel with the history sync but is a different task, so never word it as a sync.

msg_export_error.description: Toast shown when the export button failed unexpectedly, for example when the download could not be prepared. $1 is the raw error text from the browser.

msg_export_failed.description: Toast shown when the background refused to produce an export bundle. $1 is the reason it returned.

msg_export_success.description: Toast shown after a library export has been downloaded.

msg_generic_error.description: Stand-in for a value that could not be read, used by the cover cache statistics.

msg_import_error.description: Toast shown when an import failed for a reason with no dedicated message. $1 is the background's own English fallback text and will read as English.

n.example: Import payload must be a valid JSON object.

msg_import_error_bad_schema.message: Import failed: the backup is missing its songs or artists data.
msg_import_error_bad_schema.description: Import toast for a bundle that parsed as JSON but does not match the export schema.

msg_import_error_not_json.message: Import failed: the file is not a JSON object.
msg_import_error_not_json.description: Import toast for a payload that is not a JSON object at all.

msg_import_error_unrecognized_format.message: Import failed: this is not a recognized YTMusic Counter backup.
msg_import_error_unrecognized_format.description: Import toast for a JSON file that contains no songs, artists or albums, in other words somebody else's export.

msg_import_invalid_json.description: Toast shown when the chosen file could not be parsed as JSON at all, before it was ever sent to the background. $1 is the parser's own message.

n.example: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 412

msg_import_success.description: Toast shown after a successful library import. All three arguments arrive already pluralized, in the order songs, artists, albums (e.g. "40 songs, 12 artists, 9 albums"). Keep the order and treat each as a finished phrase.

msg_nav_tab_about.description: Label of the third navigation tab, which holds the extension description and contact links. Short - one word preferred.

msg_nav_tab_overview.description: Label of the first navigation tab, which shows the listening statistics summary. Short - one word preferred.

msg_nav_tab_settings.description: Label of the second navigation tab, which holds configuration, sync and data management. Short - one word preferred.

msg_openOverview.description: Label of the footer button in the popup that opens the full Details/Overview page.

msg_pillAlbums.description: Label of the third stat pill in the popup hero block, under the number of tracked albums.

msg_pillArtists.description: Label of the second stat pill in the popup hero block, under the number of distinct artists.

msg_pillCompleted.description: Label of the fourth stat pill in the popup hero block, under the number of albums that have been listened to from start to finish at least once. This is a status word, not a noun; the same word marks a completed album elsewhere in the UI.

msg_pillSongs.description: Label of the first stat pill in the popup hero block, under the number of distinct songs.

msg_refreshStats.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label for the refresh icon button in the popup header, next to the brand. Reloads the play statistics from storage. Keep it short enough to work as a button tooltip.

msg_relative_just_now.description: Elapsed time for anything under a minute. Deliberately not a relative-time phrase: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat cannot produce this without making the number explicit.

msg_relative_recently.description: Vague elapsed time used when no timestamp is recorded at all, for example the sync pill before the first sync. Deliberately vaguer than msg_relative_just_now.

msg_scan_error_scan_failed.message: The scan could not be completed.
msg_scan_error_scan_failed.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress error code "scanFailed": a history scan failed while importing the plays it had found. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_error_untrusted_source.message: The extension rejected the request as coming from an untrusted page.
msg_scan_error_untrusted_source.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress error code "untrustedSource": the extension refused a message because it did not come from its own page. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop. Users should never normally see this; it indicates a broken install or a tampered page.

msg_scan_reason_complete.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress reason "complete": the scan ran normally to the end, with nothing unusual to report. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_reason_end_of_history.message: Reached the start of your listening history.
msg_scan_reason_end_of_history.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress reason "endOfHistory": the scanner scrolled back to the beginning of the listening history without finding the previous sync position, so there was nothing left to read. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_reason_full_history.message: Reached the 200-song history limit. Reopen the History page to sync further.
msg_scan_reason_full_history.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress reason "fullHistory": YouTube Music only exposes the most recent 200 history entries per page load, so the scan stopped after 200 entries. Two sentences; the second tells the user what to do next. Keep the number 200 as written unless your language has a different convention for expressing it. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage.

msg_scan_reason_navigated_away.message: The History page was closed before the sync finished.
msg_scan_reason_navigated_away.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress reason "navigatedAway": the user left the YouTube Music History page while the scan was still running, so it was stopped. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_reason_up_to_date.message: Nothing new since the last sync.
msg_scan_reason_up_to_date.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress reason "upToDate": a scan ran and the history contained nothing newer than the previous sync. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_step_boundary.message: Finding where the last sync stopped...
msg_scan_step_boundary.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress step "boundary": the scanner has loaded history entries and is matching them against the stored sync position so it can resume instead of re-reading everything. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis.

msg_scan_step_done.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress step "done" when no more specific reason accompanies it: the sync completed without anything further to explain. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_step_failed.message: The sync stopped with an error.
msg_scan_step_failed.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress step "failed". Prefer the matching msg_scan_error_* string when one applies; this is the generic fallback. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a full stop.

msg_scan_step_importing.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress step "importing": the harvested plays are being written into the library. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis.

msg_scan_step_progress.description: Scanner-panel line combining a step description with its progress. $1 is an already-localized step phrase such as "Importing your plays...", $2 is how many items have been processed and $3 how many there are in total. Treat $1 as a finished phrase. Keep the parentheses and the slash order intact.

msg_scan_step_saving.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress step "saving": the imported batch is being persisted. Names its object like its siblings ("Scanning your history...", "Importing your plays...") - do not shorten it to a bare "Saving...". Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage.

msg_scan_step_scanning.description: Scanner-panel line for the scanProgress step "scanning": walking the History page looking for plays. Composed at render time from a machine code, never written to storage. Full sentence with a trailing ellipsis.

msg_scanner_enrich_progress.description: Counts row of the scanner panel during an album-metadata backfill. $1 albums resolved so far, $2 in total.

msg_scanner_enrich_resolving.description: Counts row of the scanner panel during a backfill that has not yet worked out how many albums it will fetch.

msg_scanner_finding_songs.description: Scanner-panel line before a sync has identified its first track.

msg_scanner_in_progress.description: Label of the Start Sync button while a sync is running.

msg_scanner_interrupted.description: Scanner-panel line when a sync stopped reporting and there is no step left to describe.

msg_scanner_interrupted_hint.message: $1 Reopen the history page to resume.
msg_scanner_interrupted_hint.description: Scanner-panel line combining whatever the scan last reported with the advice to reopen the History page. $1 is an already-localized status phrase, so treat it as a finished phrase and keep the sentence boundary.

msg_scanner_live_counts.description: Counts row of the scanner panel during a live sync. $1 arrives already pluralized ("12 plays" / "1 play") and $2 is an already-pluralized song phrase ("40 songs" / "1 song"). Both are finished phrases - do not attach a noun to either, only arrange them.

msg_scanner_metadata_fetching.description: Badge on the scanner panel while album-metadata enrichment is running.

msg_scanner_metadata_ready.description: Badge on the scanner panel once album-metadata enrichment has finished.

msg_scanner_now_playing.description: Scanner-panel line naming the track a live sync has just read, for a track that carries no album. $1 is the title, $2 the artist. Both come from YouTube Music and are inserted as plain text, never as markup.

msg_scanner_now_playing_album.description: Scanner-panel line naming the track a live sync has just read, with the album appended. $1 title, $2 artist, $3 album. All three come from YouTube Music and are inserted as plain text, never as markup.

msg_scanner_plays_synced_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_scanner_plays_synced" plural set, selected with plural('msg_scanner_plays_synced', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_scanner_plays_synced_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_scanner_plays_synced" plural set, selected with plural('msg_scanner_plays_synced', n).

msg_scanner_start_sync.description: Label of the button that launches a history sync, in its idle state.

msg_settings_backup_desc.message: Export your complete play counts, listening durations, and album completions as a standardized, versioned JSON bundle, or import an existing backup.
msg_settings_backup_desc.description: Explanation of what the export contains and that an existing backup can be re-imported. "JSON" is a format name and is not translated.

msg_settings_backup_title.description: Title of the export/import card. '1-Click' promises that a single action is all it takes - keep that promise in the translation.

msg_settings_cancel.description: Button that abandons the reset confirmation flow at any step. One key shared by all three cancel buttons.

msg_settings_confirm_step1_button.description: Button that advances from the first to the second reset confirmation step. $1 is the current step, $2 the total. The parentheses are part of the English convention - translate the intent, not the punctuation.

msg_settings_confirm_step1_note.message: This will erase all recorded play counts and statistics from the extension.
msg_settings_confirm_step1_note.description: Body text of the first reset confirmation step.

msg_settings_confirm_step1_title.message: Are you sure you want to reset all data?
msg_settings_confirm_step1_title.description: Question heading of the first reset confirmation step.

msg_settings_confirm_step2_button.description: Button that advances from the second to the final reset confirmation step. $1 is the current step, $2 the total.

msg_settings_confirm_step2_note.message: All your stats, including top songs, artists, and album progress, will be permanently removed.
msg_settings_confirm_step2_note.description: Body text of the second reset confirmation step, naming the specific data that will be lost.

msg_settings_confirm_step2_title.message: Please double-check: this cannot be undone!
msg_settings_confirm_step2_title.description: Question heading of the second reset confirmation step, escalating the warning.

msg_settings_confirm_step3_button.description: The irreversible button that actually performs the data wipe. Must read as destructive and final. $1 is the current step, $2 the total.

msg_settings_confirm_step3_note.message: Clicking the button below will immediately clear all your stored data.
msg_settings_confirm_step3_note.description: Body text of the final reset confirmation step, stating that the action takes effect immediately.

msg_settings_confirm_step3_title.message: Final confirmation: reset all data now?
msg_settings_confirm_step3_title.description: Question heading of the final, irreversible reset confirmation step.

msg_settings_confirmation_final.description: Badge on the last step of the reset confirmation flow. Separate key from the earlier steps so the '(Final)' emphasis can be rendered idiomatically. $1 is the step number, $2 the total.

msg_settings_confirmation_of.description: Badge on the first two steps of the reset confirmation flow. $1 is the step number, $2 is the total step count; both are single digits in the English catalog and are supplied as literal attribute text.

msg_settings_debug_check_storage.description: Debug button that reads and reports the state of extension storage.

msg_settings_debug_clear_logs.description: Debug button that empties the on-page diagnostics console.

msg_settings_debug_console_placeholder.message: Diagnostics initialized. Activity and error logs will appear here in real time.
msg_settings_debug_console_placeholder.description: Initial text of the on-page debug console before any log line arrives. Developer-facing, but it is fixed UI chrome rather than log output, so it is translated like any other label.

msg_settings_debug_fetch_missing.description: Debug button that requests metadata for tracks whose tracklists are not yet cached.

msg_settings_debug_min_tracks.description: Label of the numeric debug input controlling how many tracks are bundled into one metadata request. Abbreviate 'Minimum' to fit the tight debug bar.

msg_settings_debug_options_desc.message: Show developer diagnostics, connection checks, and live debug logs.
msg_settings_debug_options_desc.description: Explanation of what the Debug Options toggle reveals.

msg_settings_debug_options_title.description: Title of the toggle that reveals the developer diagnostics section.

msg_settings_debug_ping.description: Debug button that pings the content script to verify it is alive and responding.

msg_settings_debug_reset_boundary.description: Debug button that clears the history sync watermark so the next sync re-scans from scratch. 'Boundary' is the project's term for that watermark - keep it as one word if the target language has a natural compound, otherwise pick the clearest ordinary word for the scan position.

msg_settings_debug_section_title.description: Heading of the hidden diagnostics section revealed by the Debug Options toggle.

msg_settings_debug_tag_boundary.description: Transient debug status tag reporting the history sync watermark. Same 'Boundary' terminology as the Reset Boundary button.

msg_settings_debug_tag_scanner_active.description: Scanner row of the debug panel while a history sync is running. $1 is an already-pluralized play phrase such as "12 plays" - treat it as a finished phrase.

msg_settings_debug_tag_scanner_idle.description: Initial debug status tag showing the history scanner is not running. Paired with 'Boundary'/'Storage' tags that use the same 'Label: State' punctuation, so keep the colon.

msg_settings_debug_tag_storage.description: Transient debug status tag reporting the result of the storage check.

msg_settings_debug_tag_tracklists_idle.description: Initial debug status tag showing the metadata / tracklist fetch pass is not running. 'Tracklists' is the platform name for a song's track listing - do not translate it as a literal musical track list.

msg_settings_debug_tag_yt_tab.description: Transient debug status tag reporting whether the content script is present on a YouTube Music tab. "YT" is an abbreviation of the product name and should stay abbreviated.

msg_settings_export_library.description: Button that downloads the full library as a JSON file. The (.json) suffix is a literal file extension - keep it exactly as written.

msg_settings_import_library.description: Button that opens a file picker to restore a JSON backup. The (.json) suffix is a literal file extension - keep it exactly as written.

msg_settings_language_desc.message: Choose the language used for this extension's own interface text.
msg_settings_language_desc.description: Helper text under the language dropdown label. Clarifies that the setting covers the in-page UI only, which is what users often misunderstand.

msg_settings_language_follow_browser.description: Label of the language dropdown's first option, which is the empty value meaning 'use whatever language the browser is set to'. Not a language name - it is an instruction.

msg_settings_language_label.description: Label for the language dropdown. Also used as the dropdown's accessible name for screen readers, so keep it short enough to work as an aria-label.

msg_settings_language_manifest_note.message: The extension name and description shown in your browser's extension manager always follow the browser's own language setting and cannot be changed here.
msg_settings_language_manifest_note.description: Disclaimer explaining a platform limitation: the browser resolves the manifest name and description from the BROWSER locale at install/update time, so no in-page setting can override them. Must not promise the user any way to change them - that would be false on both Chrome and Firefox.

msg_settings_panel_subtitle.message: Manage your extension settings, sync history, and data preferences.

msg_settings_panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the Settings tab. The section covers both preferences and stored data.

msg_settings_reset_all_button.description: Label of the button that enters the 3-step reset confirmation flow. Same wording as the card title immediately above it - keep the two consistent in every locale.

msg_settings_reset_all_desc.message: Permanently clear all your saved play counts, artists, and album listening history. This cannot be undone.
msg_settings_reset_all_desc.description: Warning describing exactly what Reset All Data destroys. The final sentence must stay a clear, unambiguous statement that the action is irreversible.

msg_settings_reset_all_title.description: Title of the danger-zone card. Same wording as the button below it - keep the two consistent in every locale.

msg_settings_reset_success.message: All data has been reset to zero.
msg_settings_reset_success.description: Confirmation shown in the green success alert once the data wipe completes.

msg_settings_scanner_badge_complete.description: Badge on the scanner panel after a sync that imported new plays.

msg_settings_scanner_badge_failed.description: Badge on the scanner panel after a sync that ended with an error.

msg_settings_scanner_badge_interrupted.description: Badge on the scanner panel when a scan stopped reporting - its tab was closed - so there is no verdict to show.

msg_settings_scanner_badge_syncing.description: Status badge in the live scanner panel, shown before any track has been imported. details.js replaces this badge text with 'Fetching Metadata' / 'Metadata Ready' while the enrichment pass runs, so this is specifically the initial scanning state.

msg_settings_scanner_badge_up_to_date.description: Badge on the scanner panel after a sync that found nothing new to import.

msg_settings_scanner_connecting.description: Placeholder track name shown in the scanner panel before the first track arrives.

msg_settings_scanner_now_syncing.description: Label introducing the name of the track currently being imported. Ends with a colon because a track name follows it.

msg_settings_scanner_plays_found.description: Count readout beside the scanner status badge, showing zero before the scan begins. This is a static string; the live count that replaces it is rendered separately by details.js. Translate it as the zero-state wording and keep it consistent in tone with the live count.

msg_settings_section_backup.description: Heading of the section covering library export and import.

msg_settings_section_cover_art.description: Heading of the section covering the cached album artwork.

msg_settings_section_history_sync.description: Heading of the section that imports past listening history from YouTube Music.

msg_settings_section_language.description: Heading of the language selector section in Settings.

msg_settings_section_reset_data.description: Heading of the danger zone where all stored data can be erased.

msg_settings_start_history_sync.description: Button that launches the background history scanner. Verb-first button label.

msg_settings_sync_previous_desc.message: Import past plays directly from YouTube Music to include your previous listening history in your stats.
msg_settings_sync_previous_desc.description: Explanation of what the history import does. "YouTube Music" is a product name and is not translated.

msg_settings_sync_previous_title.description: Title of the history import card inside the sync section.

msg_settings_sync_status_checking.description: Transient status text in the sync pill while the extension reads the stored sync watermark. Shown for a moment on page load, then replaced. Keep the ellipsis convention of the target locale.

msg_settings_thumbnail_cache_calculating.description: Placeholder shown in the thumbnail cache badge while the size is being computed.

msg_settings_thumbnail_cache_check_size.description: Button that recomputes the thumbnail cache entry count and total size.

msg_settings_thumbnail_cache_clear.description: Button that deletes all cached album artwork. "Cover" here means album art, not a book jacket.

msg_settings_thumbnail_db_desc.message: Album covers are downscaled to 128×128 WebP and stored in IndexedDB for instant, zero-flicker offline rendering.
msg_settings_thumbnail_db_desc.description: Explanation of the thumbnail cache. "WebP" and "IndexedDB" are proper technical names and are not translated; keep the numbers 128 and 128 exactly as written.

msg_settings_thumbnail_db_title.description: Title of the card describing the on-device album art cache.

msg_settings_toggle_debug_options.description: Tooltip on the Debug Options switch. Rendered as a mouse tooltip, so keep it short and verb-first.

msg_sync_status_ready.message: Sync Status: Ready for first sync
msg_sync_status_ready.description: Text of the history sync pill before any sync has run.

msg_sync_status_synced.description: Text of the history sync pill after a sync. $1 is an already-localized relative time such as "2 hours ago"; $2 is the title of the newest tracked song, which comes from YouTube Music and is inserted as plain text.

msg_tabTopAlbums.description: Label of the third tab button in the popup's ranked-lists card (Top Songs / Top Artists / Top Albums).

msg_tabTopArtists.description: Label of the second tab button in the popup's ranked-lists card (Top Songs / Top Artists / Top Albums).

msg_tabTopSongs.description: Label of the first tab button in the popup's ranked-lists card (Top Songs / Top Artists / Top Albums).

msg_totalDurationTooltip.description: Hover tooltip on the listening-time line under the total-plays counter (the line showing the clock emoji and a duration such as '0 min').

msg_tracks_one.description: Singular form of the "msg_tracks" plural set, selected with plural('msg_tracks', n). French uses this form for 0 as well as 1, so it must read correctly at zero.

msg_tracks_other.description: Plural form of the "msg_tracks" plural set, selected with plural('msg_tracks', n).
